stages_jan_mar_2018.reading: Positive = this stage's change raised the late rate.

recommendations.title: Send the review survey on confirmed delivery, not at promise + 2 days
recommendations.why: 70% of late orders are rated before they arrive.
recommendations.confidence: High on direction, medium on size

recommendations.title: Don't roll out shorter promises. A/B-test a capped cut (lane-P80, at most 5 days shorter) outside peak season
recommendations.why: Full year: lane-P80 saves 6.4 days but late rises 9.3% → 20.6%. Oct–Mar, today's promise was already 12.5% late; the pre-set rule picks 'lane recalibrated to 7pct late', which lengthens peak promises.
recommendations.impact: Rollout cost +3,428 1–2★/yr today, +463 after #1. Break-even: +0.071% conversion per day saved. A/B variant (capped): −6.4 d, late 20.6%
recommendations.date: start 2018-09-17, read out 2018-10-15 (before the Black Friday freeze)

ab_design.unit: customer (cookie), 50/50, all lanes; treatment promise = max(lane-P80, current - 5 days)
ab_design.primary_metric: checkout conversion of sessions that saw a promise
ab_design.kill_rule: stop if treatment late rate exceeds control by 3 pp for 7 consecutive days, or 1–2★ share is +1 pp
ab_design.conversion_mde_note: needs session counts (not in the Olist extract): MDE ≈ 2.8·sqrt(2c(1−c)/S) for conversion c and S sessions per arm

recommendations.title: Fix partial shipments: mark 'delivered' only when every item has arrived, and announce split shipments
recommendations.why: 'Incomplete order' is a top-two complaint on ON-TIME orders (23%, CI 19%–27%); 65% are multi-item orders (12% of reviews).
recommendations.impact: ≤ 973 1–2★/yr on R$220k/yr of orders (upper bound); raises the measured late rate
recommendations.cost: product + seller ops; also put the 82 'fix-first' sellers (22% of GMV, 87% on-time) on a quality plan

demoted: Lane/carrier programme: against a lane-adjusted baseline (distance, destination, origin, month) the 10 worst lanes have only 277 excess late orders/yr (≈57 1–2★ recorded, 20 post-delivery). That is down from 1,143 against the network average. There is no carrier ID, so 'switch carrier' cannot be analysed.

Money on reviews: in a seller-week panel, one extra 1–2★ review is associated with −R$13 of the seller's next-4-week GMV (95% CI −R$62 to R$36, p=0.60): not detectable, so no BRL is attached to review gains.

late_orders_per_year.rec3: raises measured late rate (not quantified: no item-level delivery timestamps)

net.interactions: Rec 1 cuts the review cost of Rec 2 by about 86%. Rec 3 delays the recorded delivery, which delays the survey under Rec 1 and raises the measured late rate. The effects are not additive; the lever sizes are upper bounds.
